notes: Vanilla Fury at 60: Bloodthirst on cooldown, Whirlwind while it is down, Execute below 20 percent, Heroic Strike as the rage dump. Rage, not the global cooldown, is the limiting resource, so Bloodrage is used on cooldown; Death Wish and Recklessness are held for the execute phase unless that costs a use. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/ (the one its manifest.json records last); a later Forever patch may renumber them and tests/test_apl.py will say so. Nothing here is Forever-specific yet: the validation job (design section 6) is the evidence for changing it. 2026-11-02 (launch guide rewrite, round-11 engine, 10000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, raid / bare): Bloodrage then Battle Shout before the pull, no Charge (the pre-pull Bloodrage puts the warrior in combat, so Charge cannot be cast; a Charge in Battle Stance with the swap back measured a wash then: -0.2% raid, +0.3% bare), Whirlwind on cooldown behind Bloodthirst instead of only while Bloodthirst is down, Heroic Strike from 60 rage and none from 25% once Execute is trained (pooling with no Execute to spend it on lost 7% at 20). 750.0 to 755.1 raid (+0.7%), 272.0 to 277.0 bare (+1.8%); bare by level 34.5 to 34.3 at 20, 59.9 to 59.5 at 30, 125.0 to 126.2 at 40, 190.3 to 193.2 at 50. Hamstring under a Windfury Totem lost at every rage threshold tried (0, 40, 60), so Fury has no Hamstring line. 2026-11-03 (round 12): the pre-pull Battle Shout is skipped when a raid warrior's shout is already up; solo and bare levels still shout. Client 1.60.1.70755: Raging Blows is gone (its node is Improved Whirlwind, 2 sec off Whirlwind's cooldown and 30% more damage to the closest target), and Reckless Swings (1329555, a talent ability: 15 sec cooldown, the next four landed white swings within 8 sec each generate 5 more rage, 25% of base health) is cast on cooldown right behind Whirlwind.

priorityList.notes: Whenever rage is under 80: 10 rage at once and 10 more over 10 seconds, back every minute.
At the pull only if a second one fits before the boss dies. Otherwise hold it for the execute phase, or for the last 30 seconds when that phase is short.
In the execute phase, or in the last 15 seconds when that phase is short. It is a once-a-fight button.
Whenever it drops. It is 10 rage for the whole group's attack power.
First, below 20%: it beats Bloodthirst there and takes every point of rage you hold.
On cooldown: the button you lose the most by delaying.
On cooldown, right behind Bloodthirst: it hits up to four targets with both weapons.
On cooldown, right behind Whirlwind: your next four white swings each bring 5 more rage, and it costs a quarter of your base health, which the healers cover.
Only before level 36, while you still fight in Battle Stance. Once Whirlwind is trained you live in Berserker Stance and it never comes up.
Only above 60 rage, and never from 25% down: hold that rage for Execute. It is queued on your next swing and costs no global cooldown.
